intro: The Explosive Stick of Gann is a customized blasting charge assembled by Gann Stonespire using stolen dwarven schematics. It was designed specifically to sabotage the dwarven flying machine stationed at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens.

p: When the dwarven Prospector Khazgorm led the Ironforge excavation into southern Kalimdor, the dwarves drove the Stonespire tauren from their ancestral village and razed their sacred grounds to build the fortress-dig of Bael Modan. Driven by vengeance and a desire to honor his displaced and fallen kin, Gann Stonespire reclaimed Khazgorm's blueprints to turn dwarven engineering against the invaders. By studying the recovered plans, Gann assembled this specialized charge with enough concussive force to wreck heavy machinery.
